items.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018
items.q: as it would for any composer, whether they’re Beethoven or Bach or Stravinsky.

ctx.x: Well avante garde means, you know, new, cutting edge. But this is music that has been played since 1971 you know. So I mean it’s not new anymore. So avant garde is a term — just to put it in a box and everything. And free jazz, if you listen to Sam Rivers and other very sophisticated progressive players, they’re not playing free. There’s a lot of structure in what they’re playing. And I don’t play free. There’s a lot of structure in what I play. I play it freely, but it’s not just playing anything at any time I…

The final structure comes after we completed composing the piece, as it would for any composer, whether they’re Beethoven or Bach or Stravinsky. I mean their structure comes after the piece is completed.
